fees.notes: Official UNISEL international tuition fee for this programme: RM36,705 total programme fee. Source: https://unisel.edu.my/program-post/diploma-in-sports-industry-management/ (accessed 2026-09-18). fees.per_year = total / 3 years (official programme duration). Excludes registration and other non-tuition charges.

requirements.general: Passed SPM/SPMV with at least 3 credits in any subject, or Passed STAM (Maqbul), or Passed STPM with a minimum of 1 'C', or Passed O-Level with a minimum of 3 'C', or Passed SKM (Level 3) and SPM with a minimum of 1 credit, or Passed Community College Certificate (Level 3 equivalent) and SPM with a minimum of 1 credit, or Passed UEC with a minimum of 3 'B', or Passed any Certificate (Level 3, MQF) with a minimum CGPA of 2.00, or Any accredited or recognized qualifications that are equivalent to the above.
